A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe MSTAR and the MQTR benchmark. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and can be matched despite relocation, renumbering, and added analyses.

before.justification: v1 reports original MSTAR retrieval results on MQTR and public benchmarks, component ablations, and qualitative localization experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds quantitative localization, computation-cost, text-scale, and dataset-composition analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1-3.5 retain the same PVE/SAS procedure, instruction-conditioned encoding, two-branch multi-instance matching, losses, and reranking. The new analyses evaluate existing components rather than introduce a revised method.

E1.justification: Appendix C.2 adds evaluation against masks covering all annotated text regions in CTW, extending beyond v1's qualitative query-conditioned localization examples. The retrieval datasets, training sources, and four MQTR query types remain unchanged; the scale analysis subdivides existing ICDAR2015 coverage.

E2.justification: The retained retrieval comparisons have the same comparator membership; BLIP2 becoming BLIP-2 is only renaming. v2 newly includes BLIP-2 against MSTAR in quantitative text-mask localization (Table 12), whereas v1's localization examples have no comparator. The computation and scale analyses reuse the existing no-PVE control.

E3.justification: New supplementary protocols evaluate mask IoU and counts above IoU 0.5 on 500 CTW images, and retrieval across five text-area intervals after excluding out-of-range positive images. The main training and retrieval settings remain unchanged. Appendix C.3 describes AP, although Figure 6 labels its axis Accuracy.

E4.justification: Appendices B.3 and C.1-C.3 substantially expand the analytical evidence with query-composition statistics, PVE computation costs, quantitative localization accuracy, and a scale-stratified PVE ablation. These address benchmark diversity, efficiency, spatial accuracy, and small-text behavior beyond the retained component, binarization, iteration, and qualitative analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new query distributions are descriptive dataset analyses, not changes to experimental uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Scores in retained Tables 2-9 are unchanged, but v2 adds substantial quantitative evidence. Table 12 reports mean IoU of 50.82 for MSTAR versus 21.78 for BLIP-2, with 304 versus 129 masks reaching IoU 0.5. Table 11 adds 310 versus 248 GFLOPs for MSTAR and its no-PVE control; Figures 5-6 add query distributions and scale-dependent results. These are newly reported results, not version-to-version performance gains.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and Equations 1-5 are unchanged. Neither version contains theoretical propositions or proofs, and the added empirical metrics and scale grouping introduce no new formal result.

C1.justification: Both versions claim a box-free multi-query retrieval method, introduce the four-query MQTR benchmark, and retain the headline Total-Text and MQTR improvements. Rewriting the conclusion and changing its future outlook do not alter these core contributions.

C2.justification: v2 explains PVE's computation trade-off through reuse of ViT features and interprets the new query statistics as evidence of linguistic and structural diversity. Its conclusion shifts future emphasis toward weakly supervised document foundation models. The small-text limitation is retained; the positional-supervision explanation already appeared in v1 Section 4.4.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 newly specifies DFS for combination generation and documents manual redundancy filtering, without establishing that construction changed. It also removes the stated 8k HierText contribution without supplying a replacement count. Computation and latency information is added, while the four-stage training recipe and code/data access link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds five cited works concerning video keyframe detection, WordArt recognition, PDF-Wukong, and handwriting verification. The introduction broadens application motivation, but the positioning against box-supervised retrieval and spotting methods and the principal novelty claim remain intact.

P1.justification: v2 corrects terminology and grammar, standardizes BLIP-2 naming, removes the duplicated definition of N, and rewrites the conclusion. Author contact information, acknowledgements, and appendix subsections are added; existing training and visualization sections move later within Appendix C. The main narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figures 5-6 and Tables 11-12. The earlier training and retrieval-visualization tables become Tables 13-14, Figure 1 moves to the second page, and several displays reflow. Existing diagrams and qualitative image examples are retained rather than replaced.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens v1's qualitative localization evidence with a 500-image quantitative comparison and supplements aggregate PVE ablations with results by text scale. Computation costs and dataset details also make the evidence easier to assess. These are useful, bounded improvements; the new scale plot's AP/Accuracy naming mismatch and unspecified HierText contribution leave some reporting imprecision.
